patch_description: Split the 12 CZ gates into 3 separate entangling layers (4 CZ each, corresponding to the 3 perfect matchings of the hypercube), and interleave shared RY rotation layers between them. This is a well-established technique that maximizes circuit expressibility: consecutive diagonal CZ gates without intermediate rotations create only one effective entanglement layer, while separating them with non-commuting RY rotations creates three genuinely independent entanglement rounds. The design maintains full parameter sharing (all qubits get the same angle per layer) for strong regularization, resulting in only 7 unique params per block (44 total) vs 4 (26 total) in the current design.
